Monitoring: Observations can be carried out at any time of the day.

Take action when 5-10% of plants are damaged by mites.
Direct Control: Boil 1kg leaves with 5 litres of water.
Extract: soak 50g crushed seeds with 1 litre of water for 24 hrs.
Oil + soap solution: 5ml of neem oil with 1 litre of water.
Restrictions: When using a pesticide, always wear protective clothing and follow the instructions on the product label.
Do not use chemicals with the same mode of action year after year as this can lead to resistance.
Always consult the most recent list of registered pesticides (PCPB).
